column2: Any agent in Flotilla can hand a task to another agent, and that one starts in an isolated VM of its own.
Here, Claude asks a Codex agent to check the kernel. The Codex agent gets its own thread, marked as handed off, that you can open any time.
When Codex finishes, its answer comes straight back, and Claude picks up where it left off.
Type a slash, or a dollar sign, for the skills and commands that thread's agent can run.
An at sign finds any file in the repo, and puts it in the way that agent reads it.
Attached images show as thumbnails, and every other file gets an icon for what it is.
In Settings, write instructions and pick skills from your Mac. Every agent, in every VM, gets them.
Every agent in its own isolated VM, and now they work together. This is Flotilla.
